clauses.title: Scope – Performance requirements
clauses.text: 1.  Scope - Performance requirements and tests as well as dimensions of carriers and bases used in rewirable type electric fuses having a rated current up to and including 100 A meant for alternating current systems of voltages not exceeding 650v between lines.The specification does not cover fuse-wire used in rewirable type fuses.

clauses.title: Electrical Requirements
clauses.text: 2.   Electrical Requirements

clauses.title: Preferred Voltages – Fuses
clauses.text: 2.1 Preferred Voltages - Fuses shall be rated for one of the following voltages - For ac systems - 240 V singlephase and 415 V three phase. Note - A 240 V grade fuse shall not be used in a threephase 4 wire 415 V systems.

clauses.title: Rated Currents – The
clauses.text: 2.2 Rated Currents - The preferred values shall be 16, 32, 63 and 100 A

clauses.title: The fuse
clauses.text: 2.2.1 The fuse-carrier and base shall be so designed and proportioned, that when they are carrying their rated current continuously in an ambient temperature not exceeding 40ºC, the temperature rise of the carrier and base contacts does not exceed 55ºC.

clauses.title: Rated Breaking Capacity –
clauses.text: 2.3 Rated Breaking Capacity - When tested    as prescribred  the  fuse carriers and   the  fuse base shall be deemed to have failed if one or more of the  following occur : a) Any part of the carrier or the base ignites b) The fuse carrier is rejected, c) Any part of the fuse except the fuse element and its covering is damaged to such an extent to render it unserviceable, d) Melting of the fire-wire fuse, indicating arching to metal core, and e) Arcing between fuses on tests involving 2 or more  fuses.

clauses.title: The values of rated
clauses.text: 2.3.1  The values of rated breaking / capacity recognized for the purpose of this standard are 2 kA in the case fuses of rating up to and including 16 A, and 4 kA in the case of higher current ratings at a power factor not exceeding 0.4 (lag).

clauses.title: Fuse
clauses.text: 2.4 Fuse-Wire - The fuse-wire, specified by the manufacturer for use with the fuse-carrier, shall conform to the requirements in IS 9926 : 1981*. In addition, the fuse - wire shall be capable of blowing - off within 30 minutes when carrying a current of 1.9 times the rated current of the fuse-wire and be capable of carrying 1.6 times the current rating continuously without blowing for at least 30 minutes.

clauses.title: Physical Requirements
clauses.text: 3. Physical Requirements

clauses.title: Mechanical Robustness
clauses.text: 3.1 Mechanical Robustness

clauses.title: Mechanical Endurance – At
clauses.text: 3.1.1 Mechanical Endurance - At the end of the prescribed test, the fuse base and fuse carrier shall be examined for the following : a)  The contacts shall not work loose. b) No damage shall be caused to any part of fuse carrier of fuse-base. c) There shall be no displacement of any of the component parts, and d) The saviceability of the fuse shall not have been impaired.

clauses.title: Mechanical Strength – Fuse
clauses.text: 3.1.2 Mechanical Strength - Fuse base and fuse carrier shall show neither cracks nor permanent deformation.

clauses.title: Withdrawal Force
clauses.text: 3.2 Withdrawal Force Rated Current Withdrawal Force A N 16 5  to  35 32 15  to  55 63 30 to 100 100 40 to 160

clauses.title: Requirements for ceramic material
clauses.text: 3.3 Requirements for ceramic material

clauses.title: The ceramic material shall
clauses.text: 3.3.1  The ceramic material shall be sound, thoroughly vitrified, smoothly glazed except in the case of steatite, and shall be free from defects, such as, dents and projections. The mounting surface may be left unglazed *Fuse wires used in rewirable type electric fuses up to 650 volts.

clauses.title: The glaze, which shall
clauses.text: 3.3.1.1 The glaze, which shall show no signs of crazing, shall be leadless and shall cover at least those surface which are exposed when the fuse has been mounted in the intended manner.

clauses.title: Temperature cycle – When
clauses.text: 3.3.2 Temperature cycle - When fuse-bases and fusecarrier are subjected to the temperature cycle test the ceramic material shall withstand the series of tests without breaking, cracking or crazing. In addition, the fuse-base and fuse-carrier shall comply with the requirements of  the standard when subjected to high voltage test at the end of the temperature cycle tests. 3. 3.3. Water absorption - Shall not absorb more than 2 percent of its weight of water, when broken and tested.

clauses.title: Requirements for Non
clauses.text: 3.4 Requirements for Non-ceramic Material

clauses.title: Water absorption (for non
clauses.text: 3.4.1 Water absorption (for non - ceramic material)- materials other than ceramics, required to be nonhygroscopic shall be incapable of taking up water in sufficient quantity to cause appreciable swelling, laminating, warping or changing of  the material.

clauses.title: Non Flammability – Materials
clauses.text: 3.5 Non Flammability - Materials required to be noninflammable shall be incapable of burning or giving off inflammable vapours in sufficient quantity to ignite at a pilot flame when heated for 5 minutes in an oven at 300ºC.

clauses.title: High Voltage Test –
clauses.text: 3.6 High Voltage Test - Shall withstand without puncture or flash over when ac voltage given below is applied between the parts specified and maintained for one minute. Rated Voltage of Fuse (V)          Test Voltage (rms)(V) 240 single-phase 2 000 415 three-phase 2 500

clauses.title: Insulation Resistance – Shall
clauses.text: 3.7 Insulation Resistance - Shall be not less than 10MΩ

clauses.title: Ignition Test – Specimen
clauses.text: 3.8 Ignition Test - Specimen shall not  inflame or give off inflamable vapours in sufficient quantities to ignite at the pilot flame when tested as prescribed. Note - For design and construction of fuse carrier and fuse base with regard to aspects such as material, protection, handle or grip etc. refer to 6 of the standard.

clauses.title: Dimensions of Carriers and
clauses.text: 4.  Dimensions of Carriers and Bases - The dimensions of carriers and bases used in rewirable type electric fuses shall conform to Type A dimensions given in Annex-A of the standard.

clauses.title: Tests
clauses.text: 5. Tests

clauses.title: Type Tests
clauses.text: 5.1 Type Tests a) Mechanical  test sequence : i) Visual examination ii) Test for dimensions iii) Test for mechanical endurance iv) Test for mechanical strength v) Test for withdrawal force b) Electrical test sequence : i) Test for temperature rise ii) Insulation resistance test iii) High voltage test iv) Test for  breaking capacity c) Test for proving material properties: i)   Test for water absorption (non-ceramic) ii)  Test on ceramic material iii)  Ignition test

clauses.title: Acceptance Test – Tests specified in
clauses.text: 5.2 Acceptance Test - Tests specified in [(a) - (i), (ii), (iii), (iv)] [(b) - (i),  (ii), (iii) ] [(c) - (i)] of 5.1and Temperature cycle test (for ceramic materials).

clauses.title: Routine Test – High voltage test.
clauses.text: 5.3 Routine Test - High voltage test. Note - For detailed requirements and method of tests refer to the standard For detailed information, refer to : IS 2086: 1993.
